environment.description: IoT telemetry gateway running on EC2 instance (m5.large) in us-east-1, behind NLB with TLS passthrough. Flask app runs as container on ECS Fargate with task role allowing CloudWatch and DynamoDB access. Device authentication is handled by application-level HMAC verification using keys stored in AWS Secrets Manager (software key store). The signature verification code path has a bug where it imports from key_provider which falls through to a no-op in dev builds, effectively skipping authentication. No request filtering or template sanitization layer present.

config.network: NLB with TLS passthrough, no WAF
config.auth_bypass: key_provider module returns static test key, signature check effectively skipped due to import fallback
